atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>News Jingle Radio Station</voice> In the wake of the latest announcement from the White House to raise tariffs on imports from China to up to 60 percent, the latest surveys suggest that the public believes the president made the right decision. However, experts are debating the tariff's efficiency, with some suggesting alternative routes. On social media, additional criticism has been raised, especially regarding the image of the president, with some posting opinions such as 'The president is full of himself. Everybody else doesn't like him.'Politically, growing scepticism of China across both parties has increased support for tougher trade measures.
